messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod-gpu-queue-length (us-west1) exceeded threshold. gpu_queue_length=642 (3m avg). severity=P2. Paging oncall. link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/789

pagerduty: Paging maria (oncall) — escalation after 2m if no ack.

maria (oncall): ack. seeing increased 429s from inference-api and large backlog in the gpu queue. starting triage. can folks post quick checks: cluster-autoscaler events, ASG sizes, and any recent LT/IMDS/attachrole deploys?

henry (infra): checking ASG for gpu-pool-usw1 — desired=0 min=0 max=48 current=48. ASG at max. launch template v4 applied ~0300 UTC (today).

sophie (platform): cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated failures when creating nodegroup instances: "Failed to assume role for instance profile" and "attach-role: access denied". looks like instance-profile/iam:PassRole failing during node bootstrap.

alex (sre): that matches what we saw in recent deploy log: new LT bumped the instance profile name and we didn't propagate the passrole policy to the autoscaler instance role. nodes stuck in Pending with taint gpu-provisioning=true:NoSchedule. pods pile up in k8s queue (Pending - unschedulable).

chris (eng-runtime): customers reporting degraded completion rates. I can see 20% of requests returning 503 / backend_unavailable. Lia, can you flag impacted customers?

lia (support): flagged two large tenants on the status page and sent proactive emails: AcmeAnalytics and FinSys. noted degraded responses and that we're mitigating.

maria (oncall): mitigation plan now: 1) open ASG max temporarily + add fallback LT with older instance profile 2) manual scale-up with new LT copy 3) restart cluster-autoscaler after LT fix 4) patch node taint handling to allow short-lived nodes. who can do (1)/(2)?

henry (infra): I can increase ASG max from 48 -> 72 and launch a manual scale to +10 nodes, but we need a LT that has the approved instance-profile (lt-v3). I can snapshot v4 and revert the instance profile. doing it now, will post AMI/lt ids.

sophie (platform): I'm preparing a fallback LT (lt-v3-fallback) with the old instance profile and correct iam. will attach to ASG. caution: we may need to add a short-lived tag so autoscaler ignores them for later cleanup.

alex (sre): while infra does that, I'll patch cluster-autoscaler to tolerate transient attachrole errors and set max-node-provision-time to 10m to reduce tight retries. also will add a temporary autoscaler annotation to prefer nodes from the fallback LT.

henry (infra): ASG max increased -> 72. attaching fallback LT lt-0a1b2c3d (lt-v3-fallback). issuing manual desired += 12 (launching 12 instances).

incident-bot: Deploy event: ASG update submitted by henry at 1765439922. watch for instance statuses.

maria (oncall): new nodes are starting, some still failing bootstrap due to "AttachRole: AccessDenied" during cloud-init. henry, confirm LT instance profile id and that instance role has PassRole permission.

henry (infra): verified: lt-0a1b2c3d uses instance-profile rp-gpu-node-v3. aws iam policy rp-autoscaler-role already has sts:AssumeRole for that profile. earlier LT v4 had typo in instance profile name rp-gpu-node-production (missing suffix) which caused the failures. fixed and fallback LT attached.

chris (eng-runtime): k8s nodes are now registering. cluster-autoscaler notices new capacity and starts binding pods. backlog dropping: gpu_queue_length -> 210 (1m avg). 503s down to 6%.

lia (support): updated status page: 'Degraded: Inference latency and errors for some customers in us-west1. Mitigating. ETA 15m.' customers replying, one requests ETA for full recovery.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation looks effective. next steps: 1) revert ASG max to normal after stable for 30m 2) roll forward with corrected launch template naming and policy in CI so future LT changes fail fast in staging 3) postmortem owner: sophie + henry. I'll stay on for the handoff.

alex (sre): restarted cluster-autoscaler (safe) and removed the temporary taint toleration after nodes stabilized. watch: autoscaler events show no more "attachrole" errors.

incident-bot: Metric alert resolved: gpu_queue_length < threshold for 10m. closing pager.

maria (oncall): marking as mitigated. impact window ~ 12:32 -> 12:56 UTC. severity P2. Lia please prepare customer communications noting degraded completions and acting mitigation steps; PM/SC to follow up with credits if needed.

sophie (platform): creating a short ticket to add a CI lint to LT changes and ensure instance-profile names are validated. linking runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/gpu-provisioning-runbook

henry (infra): I'll revert ASG max back to 48 in 35m and delete fallback LT. leaving this channel for postmortem notes.

maria (oncall): nice work team — thanks for quick coordination. postmortem assigned to sophie, henry.

lia (support): customer updates queued and scheduled.

chris (eng-runtime): observed small regression in token throughput for 10m during warm-up; adding to postmortem.

maria (oncall): closing incident thread; will reopen if metrics spike again.
